Rules plan
Layer correspondence

Absolute is the ruled answer (R20). Proportional jogs. The steps absolute leaves are the Ziggurat — expected, and what makes the puzzle pieces join.

Drawing type

Inert wherever the cut CROSSES a member — you meet them all regardless. It decides only the layers whose structure runs in the drawing plane, which the Structure spread rows name.

Junction rule

§14 — drag the red nodes. They snap to the boundary lattice: every point where one wall's layer boundary crosses the other's. The knife is a monotone staircase through it — the Ziggurat, literally.

Junctions — one rule each

Arm a ✎ pencil on an assembly to see the rules of its junctions.

Roof ↔ overhang (collinear)
Eave · roof ↔ upper wall
Typical Floor · floor ↔ upper wall
Lower ↔ upper wall (collinear)
Slab · slab ↔ lower wall

R28 — floors and slabs never mitre; the knife says which layers punch in. Click a row to make its knife live.
